definitions.explanation: To grasp the meaning of something. Used for understanding language, concepts, feelings, or situations.
To be able to identify or distinguish something. {違|ちが}いが{分|わ}かる (to know the difference).

definitions.gloss: to be found out, to become clear
definitions.explanation: For something to be discovered or determined. {結果|けっか}が{分|わ}かる (the results become known).

examples.japanese: {日本語|にほんご}が{分|わ}かる?
{意味|いみ}が{分|わ}かりません。
よく{分|わ}からないけど、やってみる。
examples.english: I don't really understand, but I'll try.

examples.japanese: {説明|せつめい}を{聞|き}いても{分|わ}からなかったので、もう{一度|いちど}{聞|き}き{直|なお}した。
examples.english: I didn't understand even after hearing the explanation, so I asked again.

examples.japanese: {顔|かお}を{見|み}れば{分|わ}かる。
examples.english: I can tell by looking at your face.

examples.japanese: この{料理|りょうり}のおいしさが{分|わ}かる{人|ひと}は{少|すく}ない。
examples.english: Few people can appreciate how delicious this dish is.

examples.japanese: {長|なが}く{付|つ}き{合|あ}えば、その{人|ひと}の{本当|ほんとう}の{性格|せいかく}が{分|わ}かってくる。
examples.english: If you know someone for a long time, you come to understand their true personality.

examples.japanese: {原因|げんいん}が{分|わ}かった。
{名前|なまえ}が{分|わ}かりましたか。
examples.english: Did you find out the name?
If you look it up, you'll find out.

examples.japanese: {検査|けんさ}の{結果|けっか}が{分|わ}かるまで、{一週間|いっしゅうかん}ぐらいかかります。
examples.english: It will take about a week until the test results are known.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive). No pair verb. Pattern: Xが{分|わ}かる (X is understood) - uses が not を.

ASPECT: ている indicates ongoing state. {分|わ}かっている = 'knows/understands' (current knowledge state).

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{日本語|にほんご}が{分|わ}かる (understand Japanese)
・{意味|いみ}が{分|わ}かる (understand meaning)
・{分|わ}かりました (understood/got it)
・よく{分|わ}からない (don't really understand)

Godan verb: te-form {分|わ}かって. Takes が because it expresses a state. Also written: {解|わ}かる, {判|わ}かる.
